titulo: What Really Happens When You Tap Your Credit Card
descripcion:
What happens in the two seconds after you tap: what your card number encodes, how the chip makes a one-time cryptogram, why phone payments use tokens, the journey through acquirer, network and issuer, who pays the hidden interchange fee, and the math of minimum payments. Educational content, not financial advice.
